sentences.6.4 Når kom du til Norge?: 6.4 When did you come to Norway?
Hawa is in the shop doing her shopping.
sentences.Hun har dårlig tid, for bussen går snart: She is short of time, because the bus is leaving soon, and she has to pay.
sentences.Det er kø i butikken, og Hawa rekker ikk: There's a queue in the shop, and Hawa doesn't make it to the bus.
sentences.Etterpå står Hawa på bussholdeplassen og: Afterwards Hawa is standing at the bus stop looking out for the bus.
sentences.En bil stopper, og ei dame snakker til H: A car stops, and a woman speaks to Hawa.
sentences.Hei, du går i klassen til Håvard, ikke s: Hi, you're in Håvard's class, aren't you? My name is Marit, and I'm Håvard's partner.
My name is Hawa. Nice to meet you. I was too late and missed the bus. Now I have to wait for an hour.
sentences.Jeg kjører hjem nå. Vil du sitte på med: I'm driving home now. Would you like a lift?
sentences.Hawa og Marit sitter i bilen og snakker: Hawa and Marit sit in the car and talk.
sentences.Når kom du til Norge?: When did you come to Norway?
sentences.Jeg kom til Norge for et år siden. Først: I came to Norway a year ago. First I lived at a reception centre for half a year. Five months ago I moved to Eide, and three months ago I started the Norwegian course.
sentences.Tusen takk. Jeg liker å lære norsk. Håva: Thank you so much. I like learning Norwegian. Håvard is a good teacher. A few weeks ago I started a language placement at the hotel in the town centre. I'd like to work in a hotel.
sentences.Jeg håper du får jobb. Hva gjorde du i h: I hope you get a job. What did you do in your home country?
sentences.Jeg jobbet ikke i Somalia. Jeg studerte: I didn't work in Somalia. I studied economics, and at the weekends I helped my mum and dad. In my free time I liked being with friends. Sometimes I cooked with my mum. I really liked that.
How nice. I like cooking too. Here we are. Have a nice rest of the day!
sentences.Takk i like måte! Vi ses! Takk for skyss: You too! See you! Thanks for the lift!
sentences.Hawa handlet etter skolen, men hun hadde: Hawa went shopping after school, but she was short of time and missed the bus home.
sentences.Hawa får skyss med Marit, samboeren til: Hawa gets a lift with Marit, Håvard's partner.
sentences.Hawa og Marit snakket sammen, og Hawa fo: Hawa and Marit talked, and Hawa told her about the Norwegian course and the language placement at the hotel.
